title: Is Your Blood Pressure Normal After 35?
primaryKeyword: is my blood pressure normal after 35
description: 1 in 3 adults over 35 has high BP—but guidelines changed in 2023. Learn what numbers *actually* matter for your age and when to take action.
reasoning: People are searching 'bp ai' because they’re seeing AI-powered BP tools (apps, smart cuffs, chatbots) but don’t know how to interpret results—especially amid updated AHA/ACC guidelines and rising anxiety about midlife cardiovascular risk. They want plain-language clarity, not jargon, grounded in real-life readings they’re seeing at home.
perplexityQuestions: What does it mean if my BP is 130/80 at 38?
When should I worry about a home blood pressure reading of 150/95?
Can stress or anxiety cause my blood pressure to spike into the 140s?
Is 120/80 still considered normal for adults over 35?
